material_roles_and_properties.sensitivity: Use only the already-governed per-role source intervals; do not cross-join independent extrema as a probability distribution.

material_roles_and_properties.relation: k/(rho*Cp) from the same coherent material tuple

material_roles_and_properties.sensitivity: existing material-reference ranges, including explicit zero endpoint where specified
existing 0..4e-8 W m-3 range; zero is an explicit sensitivity endpoint, never an implicit default

minimum_output.geometry_identity: T0 geometry/configuration hash and reduced-model freeze label
minimum_output.initializer_provenance: recipe/version, input authority identities, source accounting, scenario/config identity and deterministic replay identity
minimum_output.material_layer_identity: discrete layer/material role identity; never interpolate IDs
minimum_output.property_tuple_references: coherent k,rho,Cp references; kappa replay-derived as k/(rho Cp)
minimum_output.temperature: T(z,T0) in K at T0=210 Ma
minimum_output.uncertainty: source/range, role applicability, model form, support and validity kept distinct; no invented probabilities
minimum_output.validity: T0 selector, admitted support, explicit UNKNOWN/exclusion mask and validity domain
minimum_output.vertical_coordinate: ordered native vertical datum and layer/interface coordinates

must_not: T1 profile or any time step
scope: Provider implementation/validation only on explicitly joined admitted support; not T0 materialization or T0-to-T1 evolution.
validation_targets: initializer equations and source accounting consistent; no steady-state substitution
surface/base/layer interface compatibility under already selected initializer contract
finite/plausibility checks only within initializer authority
no support expansion or missing-to-zero mapping
